lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Regularly spaced grid of high-luminance circular clusters. The most prominent horizontal row consists of approximately 10-12 primary nodes positioned between the first and second lateral ridges.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a grid where the primary high-luminance nodes are centered on the vertical axes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible. The uppermost ridge exhibits a sharp vertical intensity gradient transition, with high-luminance pixels on the dorsal edge and deep shadowing immediately ventral to the ridge line.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of high-luminance circular spots concentrated primarily along the leading edge and central surface of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: A dark, elongated silhouette (consistent with a remora) is attached to the ventral surface, posterior to the right pectoral fin.
